description: This source file implements the 'Edit' feature for user profiles in an ASP.NET Core application, including command validation, request handling, and database interaction to update user data.

classes.name: Edit.UserData
classes.description: DTO class representing user data that can be edited, including optional fields for username, email, password, bio, and image.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Request command encapsulating the user data to be edited, implementing MediatR IRequest returning a UserEnvelope.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validation class for the Command, ensuring the User data is not null.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Request handler processing the user edit command: retrieves the current user, updates fields, hashes password if provided, saves changes, and returns the updated user envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Main logic for handling the edit user request: fetch current user, update fields, hash new password, save, and return updated user.
